```scala
package examples.dsl

import scala.language.implicitConversions

import menger.dsl._

/**
 * A level-2 Menger sponge in gold, on a dark floor with three-point lighting.
 */
object GoldMengerSponge:
  val scene = Scene(
    camera = Camera(
      position = (4f, 3f, 6f),
      lookAt = (0f, 0f, 0f)
    ),
    objects = List(
      Sponge(
        pos = (0f, 0f, 0f),
        spongeType = VolumeFilling,
        level = 2f,
        material = Some(Material.Gold),
        size = 2.5f
      )
    ),
    lights = List(
      Directional(direction = (1f, -1f, -1f), intensity = 1.5f),
      Directional(direction = (-1f, -0.5f, -1f), intensity = 0.5f),
      Directional(direction = (0f, 0.5f, 1f), intensity = 0.8f)
    ),
    planes = List(Plane(Y at -3, color = "#404040"))
  )

  SceneRegistry.register("gold-menger-sponge", scene)
```

level-2 volume-filling sponge, 2.5 units, gold, three directional lights (one from above shining toward +x and -z, one from above shining toward -x and -z, one from below shining toward +z), dark gray floor plane at y=-3, camera 7.8 units out at an elevated angle.
